title: Conical density lemma for purely unrectifiable sets (Mattila 15.13-15.15)
statement: Let N, m ∈ ℕ and k := m + 1. Let E ⊆ ℝ^N be purely k-unrectifiable (every countably k-rectifiable subset of E has Hᵏ-measure 0, Hᵏ = μHE[k]), let v = (v₁, …, v_k) ∈ (ℝ^N)^k, let L_v : ℝ^N → ℝᵏ be the linear map L_v(x) = (⟨v₁,x⟩, …, ⟨v_k,x⟩), and let δ > 0. For a ∈ ℝ^N and r, s > 0 let X_v(a,r,s) := {x ∈ ℝ^N : |x − a| < r, |L_v(x − a)| < s|x − a|} (the truncated cone of aperture s around the fibre a + ker L_v). Let E₁ be the set of a ∈ E such that for every η > 0 there is s ∈ (0,1) with Hᵏ(E ∩ X_v(a,r,s)) ≤ η(rs)ᵏ for all r ∈ (0,δ). Then Hᵏ(E₁) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (E : Set (Eucl N)) (v : Fin (m + 1) → Eucl N) (δ : ℝ), Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.PurelyUnrectifiable (m + 1) E → 0 < δ → (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl N)) {a | a ∈ E ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ s ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl N)) (E ∩ {x | dist x a < r ∧ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) (x - a)) : Eucl (m + 1))‖ < s * ‖x - a‖}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (η * (r * s) ^ (m + 1))} = 0
